run_pipeline_sana_image_to_video: run the SanaImageToVideoPipeline to generate a video from an input image and text prompt
run_retrieve_timesteps: run retrieve_timesteps to get scheduler timesteps from num_inference_steps or custom timesteps list
run_prepare_latents: run prepare_latents to encode an input image into latent space and initialize video latents
run_encode_prompt: run encode_prompt to generate text embeddings from a prompt using the Gemma text encoder
run_check_inputs: run check_inputs to validate pipeline arguments like prompt, image, height, and width
